newspaper.headline: Nusa Digital IT Workshop Reopens
newspaper.lead: After a long staff shortage, the Nusa Digital IT Workshop is open again on floor 2. A new technician will take help tickets and diagnostic reports from every employee.

tip.title: Tip: Check the Simple Things First
tip.text: Before taking anything apart, check power, cables, and buttons, then try a restart. Many complaints end at this step.

newspaper.classified: WANTED: A patient technician who doesn't panic at blinking lights. See Pak Joko at the IT Workshop, floor 2.

boss.title: Monday Morning Rush
boss.intro: Three tickets arrive at once before the morning meeting. Find the cause first, do not just replace the device.
